correctness.rationale: The directional-width identity follows exactly from the support functions of the two disks and the max identity. Conditioning on \(t=|u_2|\) reduces the switching locus to one angular equation. Differentiation gives the displayed first- and second-derivative formulas; all factors in the second-derivative kernel are positive on the integration domain, including for \(\delta>1\) by \((\delta^2-1)t^2<(\delta-1)/(\delta+1)<1\). The endpoint singularity is integrable. Strict convexity, monotonicity, and limiting slope \(1/2\) then follow analytically. The bundled quadrature is diagnostic only.
